context: A teacher and student discuss a culture-studies paper
purpose: Teach: チェロ/トラウマ/ジェンダー/リアリティ/エール/洗礼/ネパール/ライブラリ

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 論文、チェロを介した心理療法、面白い切り口ですね。
lines.en: Cello-mediated psychotherapy — that's a fresh angle for your paper.
lines.style: Warm, measured interest. Sits forward slightly. Each phrase lands with genuine attention, not just politeness. The pause signals she's thinking, not waiting.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。トラウマを抱える患者への効果、いくつか報告されています。
lines.en: Yes. There are a few documented cases showing the effects on trauma patients.
lines.style: Careful, precise delivery. Speaking from research rather than opinion. Slight steadiness in his voice — this matters to him, but he's not overselling it.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ジェンダー研究での音楽療法、リアリティ番組でも紹介されていました。
lines.en: I've seen music therapy in gender studies work turn up in documentaries too.
lines.style: Genuinely curious now, building on his point. Light, conversational tone. She's connecting dots aloud, inviting him to see what she's seeing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 関係者にエールを送る章、論文の特色になっていますね。
lines.en: The chapter where you acknowledge the practitioners — that's what really sets your work apart.
lines.style: Gentle probe, not a question mark. He's noticing something good and pointing it out sideways. Tentative but sincere.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 医療の新規性に対し、洗礼を受ける位置に立つ研究ですね。
lines.en: Your research is standing right at the threshold where medical innovation meets its first real test.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly distant — she's zooming out to see the bigger picture. Not lecturing, but reflecting aloud. Quiet conviction underneath.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 参考文献に、ネパールの音楽事例も、含めました。
lines.en: I made sure to include Nepali music cases in the references as well.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact but with a thread of quiet pride. He's done the work thoroughly. Says it simply, like it was obvious he would.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: デジタルライブラリで、丁寧にアクセスしてください。
lines.en: Please access those sources through the digital library — it'll be easier to track everything from there.
lines.style: Practical, helpful close. Warm without fussing. A small gift of guidance. Not dismissing him, but passing him the tool he needs.
